title: The MCP door reaches the router through wire text under a fake client
body:
`Router::handle` in `channel.rs` is the one place the socket operations live. `call_for` in `mcp.rs` reaches it by building JSON text, `json!({"to": "code", "show": arguments})`, and sending `Call::Line(String)`. `Workspace::new` registers a pseudo-client `AGENT = usize::MAX` with a literal `{"hello":{"name":"agent"}}`. `mcp_request` in `compositor.rs` calls `router.handle(AGENT, &line)`, which parses the text twice (`from_str` to `Value`, then `from_value` to `Envelope`), then keeps `Out::Line(to, ..) if to == AGENT` and drops `Host::Status`. `channel_line` matches the same `Out::Line | Out::Host(Focus | Status)`; the only difference is that filter.

Replies travel back as `Vec<String>` of wire JSON. The compositor turns scratch errors into JSON with its own `error_line(reason)`, whose shape lacks the `message` field that `channel.rs`'s `error_line(id, reason, message)` and `docs/protocol.md` have. `mcp.rs` then runs `serde_json::from_str` on every reply to look for an `"error"` key. `Request.workspace` is an `Option<u32>` that the compositor matches to produce "the MCP address names no workspace". The sender is `Arc<Mutex<Sender<Request>>>`, though calloop's `Sender` is `Clone` and `Sync`.

## Proposal

- `Router` gets typed methods, `send(from, to, verb, payload) -> Result<(usize, String), String>`, `focus(pane)` and `panes() -> Vec<PaneInfo>`; `handle` parses a line and calls them. The MCP door calls them with `from = "agent"`.
- `Request.reply` becomes `oneshot::Sender<Result<String, String>>` and `Err` maps to `CallToolResult::error`.
- `Out` flattens to `{ Line, Focus, Status }`, matched in `channel_line` only.
- `call_tool` rejects a missing `?workspace=` with `invalid_params`, and `Request.workspace` becomes `u32`.
- `struct Decade { requests: Sender<Request> }`, cloned in the service factory.

## Cost

About 120 lines across `channel.rs`, `mcp.rs`, `compositor.rs` and `workspace.rs`. The MCP error shape then matches the protocol doc.
